text:
Managing managers? It’s a whole different ball game. 🚀

When I transitioned from managing individual contributors to leading a team of managers, I quickly realized that the skills I honed as a PM wouldn’t cut it. I had to shift my focus from the nitty-gritty details to empowering my managers to shine. This was uncomfortable but crucial.

The truth is, if I couldn’t directly access my ICs, how would I ensure my managers were solving the right problems? I had to learn to trust their judgment while still providing strategic direction. It was about seeing the bigger picture, not just the daily grind. 

One takeaway? It's not enough to manage tasks; you need to cultivate leaders. With tools like outcome-conformant synthetic data, we can better predict outcomes and guide our teams. 

Reflect on your own journey: what mindset shifts have empowered you to lead more effectively? 💡
